resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register pages say a 70-foot crow's nest went up in 1939. The Oregon Lookouts page has no 1939 entry; it starts with a 1942 activation and a 1947 cabin built on a tower. The story gives both accounts.

Register pages give 45 feet for the 1951 tower; Oregon Lookouts gives 40 feet for the 1961 replacement. The brief's 12.2 m (40 ft) matches the Oregon Lookouts tower, the last one described before abandonment. The register's 1951 tower may be a different structure.
Abandonment is 1965 in the registers and 1963 on the Oregon Lookouts page. Removal is 1994 in the registers and undated on the Oregon Lookouts page.

notes_for_editor: Major disagreements: the 1939 build year and the 1951 replacement appear only in the registers; the Oregon Lookouts page documents a 1947 cabin on a tower and a 1961 40-foot replacement. Abandonment (1963 vs 1965) and removal (1994 vs undated) also differ. The story gives both accounts. Height 12.2 m is the 40-ft figure from the 1961 replacement, a conversion from the source's feet. No source describes the site today, the 1969 radio building included, or its access. The Oregon Lookouts page does not explain its 'Portland Filter Center' or 'AWS' wording, so the story does not expand either term. The brief's agency and county are consistent with the sources. One web search was run for this site; its results were not used.
